title: Finite max-flow / min-cut
abstract: Develops finite networks with real nonnegative capacities, proves cut-flow weak duality and maximum-flow attainment, and derives max-flow/min-cut equality by an augmenting-path argument.

informal.Contrib.MaxFlowMinCut.maxflow_eq_mincut: Every finite network with real nonnegative capacities and distinct source and sink admits a feasible flow and a source-sink cut whose flow value equals the cut capacity.
informal.Contrib.MaxFlowMinCut.value_le_capacity: The value of every feasible flow is at most the capacity of every source-sink cut.
informal.Contrib.MaxFlowMinCut.max_flow_exists: Every finite network with real nonnegative capacities admits a maximum-value feasible flow.
